content: The cafe is open Monday to Friday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM and Saturday to Sunday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
The cafe is located at 25 Zhongshan Road Taipei Taiwan.
Free Wi-Fi is available for all customers.
We accept cash Visa Mastercard JCB and mobile payments.
There is limited scooter parking in front of the cafe and a public car park nearby.
Reservations are available for groups of four or more people.
All drinks and food can be ordered for takeaway.
Customers with allergies should ask staff before ordering.
Small pets are allowed in the outdoor seating area.
Students receive a 10 percent discount when showing a valid student ID.
